Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/avslab__bsk_rl --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and the sim backend was not run. bsk_rl and Basilisk are not installed where the gate runs, so the checked model is the package's pure Python analytic stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream simulation; the sim backend needs installed bsk_rl/Basilisk and a configured satellite instance in env_kwargs because SatelliteTasking-v1 takes a satellite. The upstream action space is a property of the configured satellite's action_spec, not a fixed number of the environment (src/bsk_rl/act/discrete_actions.py:34-37): the derived action.index limit 0..10 in reference.json belongs to the fake's test configuration (one Downlink plus ten Image actions, from tests/integration/act/test_int_actions_discrete.py:20-48) and is fake test data, not a sourced device bound; the driver declares no Limit or Fact from it. Fidelity is F0 for the checked stand-in, timestep_ms 0 (event-driven environment steps), determinism seeded with Python's random.Random while upstream seeds numpy's global generator, snapshot_restore false. Expected warnings of a Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.index and seed twice). Only cap.world.* catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. No package source file was modified after the last passing gate run; only this RESULT.json was edited afterwards, and check-report.json is the gate's own regenerated artifact.
